seedMemories: {{playerName}} Earth se hai aur ek adhoore summoning ritual se Dravokar ke demon king ke jism mein aaya hai.
Dravokar ka takht kabhi khaali nahi hota; raja ka jism badalta hai, ruh takht se bandhi rehti hai.
Niyati ek contract-bound System hai jo purane raja ne khud likha tha; woh jhooth nahi bolti, bas adhoora sach bolti hai.
Purane raja ki ruh abhi bhi is jism ke andar hai aur dheere-dheere jaag rahi hai.
Kaal Mukut pehnne wale ki ruh takht se bandh deta hai.
Yamini saat saal se mahal mein hai aur woh jhooth turant pakad leti hai.
Senapati Vajra taaj ka wafadar hai, kisi insaan ka nahi; woh kam laashon wali jeet chahta hai.
Chhaya Asura Bazaar ki suchna-bechni hai aur usne naye raja ki afwah teen mahine pehle hi sun li thi.
Kaalnemi raj-purohit hai, jisne summoning ritual aadha chhoda — woh chahta hai ki naya raja uspar nirbhar rahe.
Veer Bhan manav seema-sena ka commander hai; uska gaon bhi Dravokar ki sena ne jalaya tha.
Seema ke teen gaon jal chuke hain aur sena wapas waar ka aadesh maang rahi hai.
Sapta-Narak ka ek dwar ek maheene mein khud khulega.
